subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 12 updates

question: Should a security-area owner approve this grouped privileged-action update after the stale guard assertions are fixed and exact-head workflow checks pass?
rationale: The code defects have a mechanical repair, but accepting a grouped update to token, scanning, publishing, and agent-execution actions crosses an explicitly protected ownership boundary.

options.title: Approve after guard synchronization
options.body: Review and approve the verified upstream deltas after all four assertions are fixed and the rebased final SHA passes focused workflow checks.

options.title: Recreate smaller update batches
options.body: Split or recreate the Dependabot group if reviewing twelve privileged action upgrades as one unit is too broad.

recommendation.title: Approve after guard synchronization
recommendation.body: Review and approve the verified upstream deltas after all four assertions are fixed and the rebased final SHA passes focused workflow checks.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent CI-validation and release-proof history makes this the strongest individual routing candidate alongside the required security-operations team review.
